Name: pnfy_MessageKeyUnique
Description: Callers address notifications by message key, so it must be unique. Also makes configuration data migration a deterministic upsert.

Name: pnfy_ApplicationKeyUnique
Description: Consumers identify themselves by application key. Enables deterministic configuration data upsert across environments.

Name: pnfy_DestinationKeyUnique
Description: Teams destinations are referenced by key and carry environment-specific IDs, so the key must be stable and unique.

Name: pnfy_TemplateKeyVersion
Description: Published templates are immutable; a new version is a new row. This pair is the natural identity.

Name: pnfy_DefinitionChannel
Description: A notification may enable a given channel only once.

Name: pnfy_DefinitionToken
Description: A token may be declared only once per notification definition.

Name: pnfy_SuppressionHashUnique
Description: Makes duplicate suppression atomic - the insert either succeeds or collides, rather than racing a read-then-write.
